reason: The text contains several named characters who are not identified as leaders. Most notably, Jedidah (יְדִידָה) is explicitly named as the mother of King Josiah but is described only in genealogical terms, with no indication of any leadership role. Additionally, several genealogical ancestors are named merely to establish lineage—such as Athaliah (father of Shaphan), Meshullam, Micaiah (father of Akbor), Tikvah, and Harhas—and these appear only as genealogical markers rather than as individuals exercising leadership. While many named characters are indeed leaders (Josiah, Hilkiah the high priest, Huldah the prophetess, Joshua the city official, and the various kings mentioned), the presence of Jedidah and these genealogical names contradicts the claim that leaders are the only named characters.
